bindisland.name: Bind Island
bindisland.chat.toggle.tooltip: Turn Bind Island on or off
bindisland.config.title: Bind Island — Settings
bindisland.config.enabled.tooltip: Show what the keys you press do.
bindisland.config.position.tooltip: Where the island appears on the screen.
bindisland.config.style.tooltip: Compact: one line. Detailed: the mod name goes on a second line.
bindisland.config.accent.tooltip: Colour of the key cap and the line under the island.
bindisland.config.scale.tooltip: Island size relative to the interface.
bindisland.config.opacity.tooltip: How dark the island background is. 0% shows only the text.
bindisland.config.duration.tooltip: How long the island stays after the last press.
bindisland.config.offset.tooltip: Distance from the edge of the screen.
bindisland.config.show_source.tooltip: Show which mod the bind belongs to.
bindisland.config.show_state.tooltip: For toggles (e.g. Litematica Easy Place, F5) show the new state: ON / OFF, camera view.
bindisland.config.animations.tooltip: Smooth growing and fading of the island.
bindisland.config.combine.tooltip: Pressing the same bind again adds ×2, ×3… instead of a new entry.
bindisland.config.stack.tooltip: How many recent presses are shown at once, one under another.
bindisland.config.mouse.tooltip: Also show binds on mouse buttons (side buttons, middle click).
bindisland.config.in_screens.tooltip: Also show hotkeys pressed while a menu is open (malilib hotkeys that work in menus).
bindisland.config.unbound.tooltip: Show keys that are not bound to anything as "no action".
bindisland.config.binds.tooltip: Choose which binds appear on the island and rename them.
bindisland.config.reset.tooltip: Back to default look and behaviour. The bind list is kept.
bindisland.binds.title: Bind Island — Binds
bindisland.binds.show_all.tooltip: Every bind appears on the island, including movement.
bindisland.binds.reset.tooltip: Hide movement, attack, use and hotbar slots again and remove custom names.
bindisland.binds.quick.tooltip: Hide everything on this key (or show it all again)
bindisland.key.title: Bind Island — key %s
bindisland.key.hint: Click a bind to show or hide it, ✎ to rename it
bindisland.chat.drag: Hover + hold Ctrl to move the island
bindisland.edit.title: Bind Island — Bind
bindisland.edit.label: Text on the island (empty = default)
